verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the source is publicly readable: the project lives in the public GitHub repo moq-dev/moq, and a community member read the Rust code, found a spec deviation, and had a fix PR merged. Nothing in the pack names the license, so the 'open license' half of the story is unverified. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement (e.g. MIT/Apache) for the repo, and first-party docs pointing to the source and its licensing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Contributing to the moq-dev/moq repo: the author found the Rust code didn't close data streams before PUBLISH_DONE as draft-21 requires. His fix PR was merged by Luke Curley.
The author describes it as catching up on 2700 PRs.
